parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism, compound_records (substrate_record_id), compound_structures (substrate), molecule_dictionary (substrate), molecule_hierarchy (parent), molecule_dictionary (parent), docs (parent). Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id = record_id. Join compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Join molecule_dictionary to molecule_hierarchy on molregno = molregno. Join molecule_hierarchy to molecule_dictionary (parent) on parent_molregno = molregno. Join molecule_dictionary (parent) to compound_records on molregno = molregno. Join compound_records to docs on doc_id. Filter organism = 'Canis lupus familiaris'. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Limit 200.
